input.title: Aventon Pace 5 REC
input.descriptionHtml:
New Aventon Pace 5 REC Step-Through ebike comfort cruiser with 750W hub motor, up to 75-mile range, regen braking, 4G/GPS, turn signals, and daytime running lights. $1,799 + $160 assembly & tuning.

Aventon Pace 5 REC - Comfort Cruiser
750W Hub Motor, 75-Mile Range

 

The Aventon Pace 5 REC is a comfort-first electric cruiser built around a low step-through frame, swept-back handlebars, an adjustable stem, and a wide 250mm saddle all tuned to put you in an upright, relaxed riding position that's easy on your back, wrists, and joints. Under that comfort package is a genuine powerplant: a 750W rear hub motor with 80Nm of torque (1,188W peak; 1,440W in Boost Mode) and a 733Wh removable battery good for up to 75 miles of range. Regenerative braking recaptures energy on descents and during braking, extending range and reducing brake pad wear. The Pace 5 REC is available in Regular and Large sizing and five colors at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL.

Smart features are built in throughout. Aventon's ACU connected platform delivers 4G/GPS tracking, an integrated rear wheel e-lock, unusual activity detection and alarm, password protection, Cruise Control, Ride Tune customization, and Apple Watch connectivity all managed through the Aventon app with over-the-air firmware updates. The Aventon A280 display is fully customizable. Integrated daytime running lights and turn signals keep you visible on the road. Note: 4G connectivity is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period. Rack and fenders are not included with the base bike and are available as add-ons.

**E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee** 

Included with every Pace 5 REC:

  • Integrated front and rear lights
  • Integrated turn signals
  • Daytime running lights
  • Throttle (left handlebar mounted)
  • 42V 4A charger
  • 9/16" composite platform pedals
 

Available as add-ons:

  • Aventon Rear Rack Set Pace 5 REC specific
  • Aventon Fender Set Pace 5 REC specific

Specs:
Motor 750W Rear Hub (1,188W Peak / 1,440W Boost)
Motor Torque 80Nm (96Nm in Boost Mode)
Battery 36V, 20Ah, 733Wh Removable Internal, LG 21700 cells
Range Up to 75 miles (est.)
Top Speed 20 mph as Class 2 - Can be raised to 28 mph as Class 3
Charge Time 5 hours (0 - 100%)
Frame 6061 Aluminum, Gravity Cast Front Triangle Step-Through
Fork Aventon Rigid Alloy
Wheels 27.5" Double Wall Aluminum
Tires 27.5" x 2.1" 33TPI
Brakes Tektro HD-E3120 2-Piston Hydraulic Disc, 180mm rotors, front & rear
Drivetrain Shimano Altus 8-Speed, 1232T Cassette, 48T Chainring
Handlebars Aventon Swept-Back Aluminum, 31.8mm, 620mm, 38mm rise
Stem 60mm, Adjustable Rise, 31.8mm clamp
Saddle Aventon 250mm Wide Comfort Saddle
Display Aventon A280 (customizable)
Smart Features Regen Braking, 4G/GPS, E-Lock, Activity Alarm, Password Protection, Ride Tune, Cruise Control, Boost Mode, Sensor Switch, Hold Mode, Apple Watch, OTA Updates
Lights Integrated Front & Rear, Turn Signals, Daytime Running Lights
Ebike Class Class 2 (Convertible to Class 1 or 3)
Weight 60.48 lbs
Weight Capacity 330 lbs
Rider Height Regular 5'0" - 5'9"
Rider Height Large 5'9" - 6'3"
Standover Height 423.9mm
Water Resistance IPX5 (bike) / IPX6 (components)
Safety Cert. UL 2849 Certified
Colors Glacier Mint, Sakura, Koi, Anvil, Lagoon
Price $1,799 + $160 assembly & tuning ($1,959 total)


Come see it in person. The Pace 5 REC is regularly on the floor at Quest Watersports
